doc.brief: The QGraphicsAnchorLayout class provides a layout where one can anchor widgets together in Graphics View.
doc.index_brief: Layout where one can anchor widgets together in Graphics View

QGraphicsAnchor * addAnchor(QGraphicsLay.brief: Creates an anchor between the edge *firstEdge* of item *firstItem* and the edge *secondEdge* of item *secondItem*.

QGraphicsAnchor * anchor(QGraphicsLayout.brief: Returns the anchor between the anchor points defined by *firstItem* and *firstEdge* and *secondItem* and *secondEdge*.

QGraphicsAnchorLayout(QGraphicsLayoutIte.brief: Constructs a QGraphicsAnchorLayout instance. *parent* is passed to [QGraphicsLayout](xref:qt:QGraphicsLayout)'s constructor.

qreal horizontalSpacing() const.brief: Returns the default horizontal spacing for the anchor layout.

qreal verticalSpacing() const.brief: Returns the default vertical spacing for the anchor layout.

void addAnchors(QGraphicsLayoutItem *fir.brief: Anchors two or four edges of *firstItem* with the corresponding edges of *secondItem*, so that *firstItem* has the same size as *secondItem* in the dimensions specified by *orientations*.

void addCornerAnchors(QGraphicsLayoutIte.brief: Creates two anchors between *firstItem* and *secondItem* specified by the corners, *firstCorner* and *secondCorner*, where one is for the horizontal edge and another one for the vertical edge.

void setHorizontalSpacing(qreal spacing).brief: Sets the default horizontal spacing for the anchor layout to *spacing*.

void setSpacing(qreal spacing).brief: Sets the default horizontal and the default vertical spacing for the anchor layout to *spacing*.

void setVerticalSpacing(qreal spacing).brief: Sets the default vertical spacing for the anchor layout to *spacing*.
